o: Compound eye
Haemocoel
Book lung
Exoskeleton
items.s: Exoskeleton is the rigid outer casing to which muscles attach and which must be shed for growth.

items.q: Flatworm may be defined as
o: one of the segments of a tapeworm, each carrying a set of reproductive organs
a ciliated excretory unit that drives fluid along a duct to remove surplus water and waste
the organism in which a parasite reaches maturity and reproduces
a soft flattened worm with no body cavity and no blood system
items.s: Flatworm: a soft flattened worm with no body cavity and no blood system. The other options describe Flame cell, Proglottid, Definitive host.
